tool.name: Biomni: Reconstruct 3D Face From Mri
tool.description: Generate a 3D model of facial anatomy from MRI scans of the head and neck.
tool.command:
python -c " import sys import json from biomni.tool.physiology import reconstruct_3d_face_from_mri
# Parse arguments args = {} i = 1 while i < len(sys.argv): if sys.argv[i].startswith('--'): key = sys.argv[i][2:] if i + 1 < len(sys.argv) and not sys.argv[i + 1].startswith('--'): val = sys.argv[i + 1] # Type conversion if val.lower() == 'true': val = True elif val.lower() == 'false': val = False else: try: val = int(val) except: try: val = float(val) except: pass args[key] = val i += 2 else: args[key] = True i += 1 else: i += 1
# Call function result = reconstruct_3d_face_from_mri(**args)
# Write output output_path = args.get('output', '/dev/stdout') with open(output_path, 'w') as f: if isinstance(result, str): f.write(result) elif isinstance(result, (dict, list)): json.dump(result, f, indent=2, default=str) else: f.write(str(result)) " --output '$output' --mri_file_path '$mri_file_path' #if $output_dir --output_dir '$output_dir' #end if #if $subject_id --subject_id '$subject_id' #end if #if $threshold_value --threshold_value '$threshold_value' #end if

param.name: mri_file_path
param.label: Mri File Path
param.help: Path to the MRI scan file (NIfTI format: .nii or .nii.gz)

param.name: output_dir
param.label: Output Dir
param.help: Directory where output files will be saved

param.name: subject_id
param.label: Subject Id
param.help: Identifier for the subject, used in output filenames

param.name: threshold_value
param.label: Threshold Value
param.help: Threshold value for initial segmentation of facial tissues

tool.help:
**Biomni: Reconstruct 3D Face From Mri**
Generate a 3D model of facial anatomy from MRI scans of the head and neck.
Parameters ---------- mri_file_path : str Path to the MRI scan file (NIfTI format: .nii or .nii.gz) output_dir : str Directory where output files will be saved subject_id : str Identifier for the subject, used in output filenames threshold_value : int Threshold value for initial segmentation of facial tissues
Returns ------- str Research log detailing the reconstruction process and output file locations
**Domain**: physiology **Function**: reconstruct_3d_face_from_mri
